column19: Concluded 27 Jan 2026 (PRS): India gets preferential access for over 99% of exports by value; EU to eliminate or cut tariffs on 96.6% of its goods exports to India; India gains access to 144 EU services subsectors and a mobility framework; dairy, rice, sugar, beef and poultry excluded; car tariffs fall from 110% towards 10% under a quota; wine 150% to 75% initially. Next steps: legal scrub, EU Council and Parliament approval, Indian ratification; signing was reported on track for December (Goyal, in the trade row).
